Class ResumeService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.ResumeService
public class ResumeService extends Object
Coordinates TA resume drafts and resume-skill linkage with transactional guardrails.

Deletion and skill replacement enforce ownership checks when operatorId is supplied, preserving demo flows that invoke service methods without an authenticated caller.

      public void delete(UUID operatorId, UUID resumeId)
      Deletes a resume only when no non-terminal applications reference it.
